name: @wildflowerhealthio/fhir-r4-adoption
description: The FHIR R4 side of extraction: a detached resource (id null, keyed by its first identifier, naming other records by logical reference), how a decoder writes one or detaches a server's record into one, and how one is adopted into the device's store. DetachedResource is that shape, reads its key and decodes a decoder's wire as one; detach(family) drops a server record's id, keys it by that id as identifier[0] in the system its SystemFamily gives its type, and turns each literal reference to another record into a logical reference by the target's key; adopt stores a keyed record under the id its key derives and a keyless one under a minted id, and resolves each logical reference by key to a literal one; adoptedReferenceOf spells one such reference from outside its source, and originalIdOf reads the source's id back off one. No DOM, no fs, no React.
